name: Marvin Coffey
source: Marvin is a shy but kind-hearted young man who lived in a secluded space colony. He dreams of having an exciting adventure like the roleplaying games he plays and has been recruited by VolTitan's priestess believing he holds great power. Little does he know a great desire burning within him holds the key to unlocking the power of VolTitan the defender of Feeternia
